title: silicone frozen pop molds
text: silicone frozen pop molds. I waited until I had actually used these - they work great.  I couple of hints... stop feeling about 1 inch from the top and then run some warm water on the outside of the frozen mold for a few seconds and twist a bit until it sort of snaps or pops up - makes it easier to push the pop up and out as you enjoy it.  I used an organic fruit juice and my grandsons (5 and 8 yrs) loved them.  I like that I can make the juice or purchase juice that is healthier than other colored drinks. They washed up nicely in the top shelf dishwasher space - no problem.  Comes with a tray that helps you fill the molds and then keeps them upright in the freezer.  Small footprint so they will fit most any freezer space.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you!

product_metadata.title: Zoku Summer Pops, 6 Squeezable Silicone Molds with Reusable Spill-resistant Lids and Tray, BPA-free
features: SIX SQUEEZABLE MOLDS: 6 molds with individual lids fit securely into the sturdy tray for easy freezing; 3-fluid ounces each
CREATE HEALTHY HOMEMADE TREATS: Use fresh ingredients and come up with your own combinations of fruit, juice and yogurt for unique popsicles, free from preservatives
NOT JUST FOR POPSICLES: These flexible pouches can also be used for dry snacks
MESS FREE GRAB-AND-GO DESIGN: Simply squeeze to enjoy, no need to run under warm water; built-in drip guards and spill-resistant reusable lids let you reseal pops or snacks to finish later

BPA-FREE AND EASY TO CLEAN: BPA and phthalate free silicone mold and polypropylene tray are easy to use and clean; do not wash in the dishwasher; clean with mild soap and water; designed in the USA; made in China
